name: Expedite Crew
desc: Unlock 1 crew member from Contract lockout instantly.

name: Rush Property
desc: Collect 1 hour of your current property income immediately. This does not increase income rate.

name: Heat Bribe
desc: Reduce Heat by 20 instantly. This only clears pressure and does not add power.

name: Golden Suit
desc: Adds a gold avatar border on Contract cards and profile displays.

name: Enforcer Tag
desc: Adds [ENFORCER] before your boss name in Street Chat.

name: Boss Skin: Nightfall
desc: Replaces your boss class image with the Nightfall boss skin.

name: Auto-Manager
desc: Automatically assigns an available crew member as manager when buying a property.

name: Heat Alerts
desc: Shows a warning when Heat reaches 45 before penalties begin.

name: Contract Intel
desc: Shows defender property bonuses before attacking a Contract target.
